mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized by CYP2C19 to meprobamate; prednisone may induce CYP2C19, potentially increasing carisoprodol metabolism and reducing its efficacy, while additive CNS depression and immunosuppression effects may occur.
action: Monitor for reduced muscle relaxant efficacy; may require carisoprodol dose adjustment; counsel on increased CNS depression risk and monitor for immunosuppression signs.
